title: DecodingTrust: A Comprehensive Assessment of Trustworthiness in GPT Models
description: This paper received the outstanding benchmarks track paper award during NeurIPS 2023 (opens in new tab). How trustworthy are generative pre-trained transformer (GPT) models?
